data.one_liner: Pure Dart post-quantum cryptography package implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA.
data.what_it_does: Implements post-quantum cryptography algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA) in pure Dart with zero external dependencies. It provides NIST-aligned cryptographic primitives with checked-in known-answer vector evidence.
use_when: You need post-quantum cryptography algorithms like ML-KEM, ML-DSA, or SLH-DSA in a pure Dart or Flutter application.
You require cross-platform cryptographic operations including Web support without native dependency headaches.
avoid_when: You need official FIPS 140 or CMVP module validation (the package does not claim module validation).
You require traditional classical-only algorithms and do not need post-quantum resistance.
strengths: Zero third-party dependencies with 100% pure Dart implementation.
Comprehensive support for ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA across all parameter sets.
Byte-exact validation against official NIST ACVP and KAT corpora.
weaknesses: No official CMVP or FIPS 140 module validation claimed.
Some parameter sets (like SLH-DSA slow variants) can be CPU-intensive in pure Dart.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; no native configuration, permissions, or build_runner required.
